title: ci-gate params
description: Operator-facing config keys for the ci-gate bundle — ADR-0081's locked decision: bundle params validate against JSON Schema. secret_env/token_env are secret NAMES, never values.

name.description: Status context base — statuses post as ci/<name>.

repo.description: owner/name to gate; empty gates every repo the ingress node watches.

status_repo.description: bupha's status redirect — post verdicts to a different repo; empty = config.repo.

cmd.description: Gate command, run inside the detached worktree.

worktree_base.description: driver-git base — worktrees and the clone cache live under it.

token_env.description: NAME of the secret holding the forge token (clone auth + status posts). Never the value.

timeout.description: Inner shell timeout in seconds (driver cap: 600).
